segments.description: Provides computing and networking solutions, including data center infrastructure, AI accelerators, and networking hardware for enterprise and cloud computing applications.
Sells graphics processing units (GPUs) for gaming consoles, PCs, and professional visualization tools used in design, engineering, and media production.

reconciling.note: All Other category includes reconciling items such as stock-based compensation, unallocated costs, acquisition-related expenses, IP-related costs, and other non-recurring charges not allocated to reportable segments.

reporting_note: The company reports two operating segments: Compute & Networking and Graphics. The 'All Other' category contains reconciling items not attributable to specific segments. Segment assets are not disclosed as the CODM does not review asset information by segment.
